items.title_en: KlaskTron: An Open-Source Platform for Physical Adversarial Multi-Agent RL
items.title_zh: KlaskTron：用于物理对抗多智能体强化学习的开源平台
items.abstract_en: Progress in robot learning, particularly physical multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), is currently challenged by a limited availability of accessible, standardized benchmarks. While simulation-based MARL has produced remarkable emergent behaviors, from coordinated team play to complex tool use, translating these advances to physical systems remains difficult. A key barrier is infrastructural: physical platforms are often prohibitively expensive, require specialized facilities, or lack open mechanisms and designs for reproducibility. We introduce KlaskTron, an open-source, low-cost (<\$2500 USD), desktop-scale robotic testbed for adversarial MARL based on the dynamic tabletop game KLASK. The platform features dual CoreXY gantries with high-torque brushless motors, enabling the high-speed, precise manipulation required for competitive play. Crucially, we provide a complete ecosystem: hardware designs (CAD, BOM), a GPU-native digital twin in NVIDIA Isaac Lab for high-fidelity modeling and simulation, and a validated sim-to-real baseline using a learned neural actuator model. We demonstrate that this baseline enables zero-shot policy transfer, with trained agents exhibiting emergent adversarial behaviors. To ensure full reproducibility of our results, all project assets are released publicly: hardware CAD/BOM and assembly documentation at [https://idscethzurich.github.io/klask_hardware], inference software stack at [https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_software] and the simulation and MARL setup at [https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_rl].
items.abstract_zh: 机器人学习，特别是物理多智能体强化学习（MARL）的进展，目前受到可获取、标准化基准有限的挑战。尽管基于仿真的 MARL 已经产生了显著的新兴行为，从协同团队配合到复杂工具使用，但将这些进展迁移到物理系统仍然困难。一个关键障碍是基础设施：物理平台通常价格高昂、需要专门设施，或缺乏可复现的开放机制和设计。我们推出 KlaskTron，一个基于动态桌面游戏 KLASK 的开源、低成本（低于 2500 美元）、桌面规模的机器人测试平台，用于对抗性 MARL。该平台具有双 CoreXY 龙门架和高扭矩无刷电机，能够实现竞技比赛所需的高速、精确操作。关键的是，我们提供完整的生态系统：硬件设计（CAD、BOM）、在 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 中用于高保真建模与仿真的 GPU 原生数字孪生，以及使用学习到的神经执行器模型验证的仿真到真实基线。我们证明该基线能够实现零样本策略迁移，训练后的智能体表现出新兴的对抗行为。为确保结果完全可复现，所有项目资产均公开发布：硬件 CAD/BOM 和组装文档见 [https://idscethzurich.github.io/klask_hardware]，推理软件栈见 [https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_software]，仿真与 MARL 设置见 [https://github.com/IDSCETHZurich/klask_rl]。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Explore with Long-term Memory: A Benchmark and Multimodal LL
items.title_en: Explore with Long-term Memory: A Benchmark and Multimodal LLM-based Reinforcement Learning Framework for Embodied Exploration
items.title_zh: 基于长期记忆的探索：面向具身探索的基准与基于多模态 LLM 的强化学习框架
items.abstract_en: An ideal embodied agent should possess lifelong learning capabilities to handle long-horizon and complex tasks, enabling continuous operation in general environments. This not only requires the agent to accurately accomplish given tasks but also to leverage long-term episodic memory to optimize decision-making. However, existing mainstream one-shot embodied tasks primarily focus on task completion results, neglecting the crucial process of exploration and memory utilization. To address this, we propose Long-term Memory Embodied Exploration (LMEE), which aims to unify the agent's exploratory cognition and decision-making behaviors to promote lifelong learning. We further construct a corresponding dataset and benchmark, LMEE-Bench, incorporating multi-goal navigation and memory-based question answering to comprehensively evaluate both the process and outcome of embodied exploration. To enhance the agent's memory recall and proactive exploration capabilities, we propose MemoryExplorer, a novel method that fine-tunes a multimodal large language model through reinforcement learning to encourage active memory querying. By incorporating a multi-task reward function that includes action prediction, frontier selection, and question answering, our model achieves proactive exploration. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art embodied exploration models demonstrate that our approach achieves significant advantages in long-horizon embodied tasks. Our dataset and code will be released at https://wangsen99.github.io/papers/lmee/
items.abstract_zh: 理想的具身智能体应具备终身学习能力，以处理长时程和复杂任务，从而在通用环境中持续运行。这不仅要求智能体准确完成给定任务，还要求其利用长期情景记忆来优化决策。然而，现有主流的一次性具身任务主要关注任务完成结果，忽视了探索和记忆利用的关键过程。为此，我们提出长期记忆具身探索（Long-term Memory Embodied Exploration, LMEE），旨在统一智能体的探索认知与决策行为，以促进终身学习。我们进一步构建了相应的数据集和基准 LMEE-Bench，包含多目标导航和基于记忆的问答，以全面评估具身探索的过程和结果。为增强智能体的记忆召回和主动探索能力，我们提出 MemoryExplorer，一种通过强化学习微调多模态大语言模型以鼓励主动记忆查询的新方法。通过引入包含动作预测、前沿选择和问答的多任务奖励函数，我们的模型实现了主动探索。针对最先进具身探索模型的大量实验表明，我们的方法在长时程具身任务中具有显著优势。我们的数据集和代码将在 https://wangsen99.github.io/papers/lmee/ 发布。

items.title_en: iMED: A Multi-Endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
items.title_zh: iMED：用于手术3D感知的多内窥镜数据集
items.abstract_en: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.
items.abstract_zh: 该文提出 iMED，首个面向机器人辅助微创手术的同步多内窥镜数据集，解决手术视觉基准缺乏独立留出视角的问题。现有数据多为单镜单轨迹，难区分几何泛化与光度插值。iMED 含340段序列、约17万同步时刻（每时刻4视角），由两个立体内窥镜在离体、尸检和活体场景采集，覆盖14标本；提供标定内参、带不确定度的ArUco位姿、器械掩码和临床元数据。采用一镜训练、另一镜测试协议，评测23种方法。依赖光度监督的方法显著退化，显式几何正则更稳健；大规模基础模型迁移良好，常优于领域专用模型。
items.highlight_zh: 首个多内窥镜同步手术数据集，揭示留出视角几何泛化差距
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：手术视觉里要判断一个3D感知算法是真懂几何，还是只在一条熟悉轨迹上做图像插值，需要“独立留出视角”。但现有手术数据集基本由单个内窥镜沿一条轨迹拍摄，训练和测试视角高度相关，难以检验跨视角几何泛化。方法：作者构建 iMED，用两个独立立体内窥镜在同一场景同步拍摄，形成每时刻4视角的数据；覆盖离体、尸检和活体场景，共14个标本，包含340段序列、约17万同步时刻。数据附带相机内参标定、基于ArUco的逐帧位姿及不确定度、器械分割掩码和临床元数据。评测采用“一镜训练、另一镜测试”协议，对23种先进方法在刚性/形变新视角合成、位姿估计、特征匹配和单目深度估计上做基准。结果：主要依赖光度监督的方法在留出内窥镜下明显掉点，而有显式几何正则的方法更稳健；大规模基础模型迁移到手术图像上表现意外地好，常超过领域专用模型，暴露出现有微调流程可能存在的问题。意义：iMED 提供了首个多内窥镜同步手术3D感知基准和更严格的几何泛化评测协议，提醒社区不要被同一轨迹上的高指标误导，也为手术视觉基础模型的选择与微调提供了新参照。

items.title_en: Clinician-AI Collaboration in Endovascular Neurointerventions: In-Vitro User Study of Copilot Assistance Modes for Robotic Navigation Across the Autonomy Spectrum
items.title_zh: 血管内神经介入中的临床医生-人工智能协作：跨自主谱系的机器人导航副驾驶辅助模式的体外用户研究
items.abstract_en: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) is an effective treatment for acute ischemic stroke, yet access remains limited by the availability of neurointerventional expertise. Telerobotic and AI-assisted systems may help address this challenge, but it remains unclear how clinicians interact with different levels of autonomy and how autonomous navigation systems perform in realistic environments. This work introduces Copilot Assistance Modes (CAMs), a framework for clinician-AI collaboration in robotic endovascular navigation spanning the autonomy spectrum from manual operation to full autonomy. In the first in-vitro user study comparing clinician-AI collaboration strategies, 11 experts and two students evaluated six navigation modes in a patient-specific vascular phantom. Objective performance metrics were combined with subjective assessments, including workload and usability. Autonomous performance was additionally evaluated both in silico and in vitro to investigate sim-to-real transfer. Hands-on manual navigation achieved the strongest overall performance (100% success). While fully autonomous navigation achieved 81% success in simulation, performance dropped to 23% in vitro. In contrast, several clinician-AI shared-autonomy modes achieved success rates of 92-97%, approximately four times higher than full autonomy and comparable to direct robotic control (95%), demonstrating mitigation of sim-to-real domain shift through clinician-AI collaboration. Among the evaluated AI-driven approaches, user-directed task delegation and rotational shared control demonstrated the most favorable balance between performance and clinician acceptance. These findings suggest that effective clinician-AI collaboration and allocation of control authority may currently be more important for reliable robotic neurointerventional navigation than increasing autonomy alone.
items.abstract_zh: 机械取栓（MT）是急性缺血性卒中的有效治疗方法，但其可及性仍受限于神经介入专业技术的可用性。远程机器人和人工智能辅助系统可能有助于应对这一挑战，但临床医生如何与不同自主水平交互，以及自主导航系统在真实环境中的表现如何，仍不清楚。本工作提出副驾驶辅助模式（CAMs），一个用于机器人血管内导航中临床医生-人工智能协作的框架，涵盖从手动操作到完全自主的自主谱系。在首个比较临床医生-人工智能协作策略的体外用户研究中，11名专家和两名学生在患者特异性血管体模中评估了六种导航模式。客观性能指标与主观评估相结合，包括工作负荷和可用性。此外，在计算机仿真和体外环境中评估自主性能，以研究仿真到现实的迁移。手动亲自导航取得了最强的总体性能（100%成功率）。虽然完全自主导航在仿真中达到81%的成功率，但在体外环境中性能降至23%。相比之下，几种临床医生-人工智能共享自主模式达到92-97%的成功率，约为完全自主的四倍，并与直接机器人控制（95%）相当，表明通过临床医生-人工智能协作可缓解仿真到现实的域偏移。在评估的人工智能驱动方法中，用户导向的任务委派和旋转共享控制在性能与临床医生接受度之间表现出最有利的平衡。这些发现表明，对于可靠的机器人神经介入导航，有效的临床医生-人工智能协作和控制权限分配目前可能比单纯提高自主性更重要。

items.title_en: GoalDex: Learning Image-Goal-Conditioned Policies for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
items.title_zh: GoalDex：学习用于灵巧手内操作的图像目标条件策略
items.abstract_en: Dexterous in-hand manipulation is commonly formulated around explicit object pose estimation, yet reliable pose tracking is challenging under severe hand-object occlusions and often requires object-specific supervision. This dependence creates a bottleneck between perception and control that can limit robustness and scalability. We present an end-to-end visuomotor framework for dexterous in-hand reorientation that operates on RGB observations and proprioception without intermediate pose estimation. Our approach jointly learns visual representations and control policies through behavior distillation from privileged state teachers and auxiliary reconstruction objectives. Furthermore, we introduce image-goal-conditioned reorientation, allowing desired object configurations to be specified directly through images rather than canonical pose representations. We evaluate our approach across a diverse set of object geometries and instances in simulation, where it consistently outperforms pose-based methods and policies built on pretrained visual encoders. Finally, we demonstrate direct sim-to-real transfer of a single image-goal-conditioned policy across five real-world objects, showing that accurate dexterous reorientation can be achieved without explicit pose estimation. For videos and code release, please refer to the project website: https://rffr.leggedrobotics.com/works/goaldex/
items.abstract_zh: 灵巧手内操作通常围绕显式物体位姿估计来建模，但在严重的手-物体遮挡下，可靠的位姿跟踪具有挑战性，且通常需要针对特定物体的监督。这种依赖在感知与控制之间形成瓶颈，可能限制鲁棒性和可扩展性。我们提出一种端到端视觉运动框架，用于灵巧手内重定向，直接基于RGB观测和本体感觉运行，无需中间位姿估计。我们的方法通过从特权状态教师进行行为蒸馏以及辅助重建目标，联合学习视觉表示和控制策略。此外，我们引入图像目标条件重定向，允许直接通过图像而非规范位姿表示来指定期望的物体构型。我们在仿真中跨多样物体几何形状和实例评估该方法，其始终优于基于位姿的方法和基于预训练视觉编码器构建的策略。最后，我们展示了单个图像目标条件策略在五个真实世界物体上的直接仿真到现实迁移，表明无需显式位姿估计即可实现准确的灵巧重定向。视频和代码发布请参见项目网站：https://rffr.leggedrobotics.com/works/goaldex/

items.title_en: Control Barrier Functions for Safety-Aware Latent-Space Motion Planning
items.title_zh: 用于安全感知潜在空间运动规划的控制屏障函数
items.abstract_en: Latent-space path planning (LSPP) compresses the configuration space of a robotic manipulator into a compact, differentiable manifold learned by a variational autoencoder, enabling fast gradient-based planning without explicit inverse kinematics. Existing LSPP frameworks enforce obstacle avoidance with a binary collision classifier, whose saturated gradients near obstacle boundaries and lack of temporal structure cause the optimizer to stall and provide no forward-invariance guarantee. We replace the classifier with a neural control barrier function (CBF) learned directly in the latent space. The barrier is trained with a three-term objective that combines safe and unsafe sign constraints with a discrete-time decrease condition evaluated on transitions of an obstacle-blind nominal planner, and it is enforced at planning time by a closed-form, first-order correction that projects each goal-directed latent step back onto the CBF constraint. On a 7-DoF Franka Panda manipulator, the CBF planner achieves a 75.6\% success rate on a fixed-obstacle task, 12.0 percentage points above the best of 35 tuned classifier configurations, and 83.8\% on a multi-position task. A sweep of the decay rate $α$ characterizes the safety--performance trade-off, with the best operating points in $α\in [0.10, 0.20]$. In a fully general random-obstacle setting, success drops to 33.0\%, which we trace to covariate shift between the obstacle-blind training transitions and the states visited by the corrected planner.
items.abstract_zh: 潜在空间路径规划（LSPP）将机器人机械臂的构型空间压缩为变分自编码器学习到的紧凑可微流形，从而无需显式逆运动学即可实现快速的基于梯度的规划。现有LSPP框架使用二值碰撞分类器来强制执行避障，其在障碍物边界附近饱和的梯度和缺乏时间结构导致优化器停滞，且不提供前向不变性保证。我们用直接在潜在空间中学习的神经控制屏障函数（CBF）替换该分类器。该屏障函数通过三项目标训练，该目标将安全和不安全的符号约束与在障碍物盲标称规划器转移上评估的离散时间递减条件相结合，并在规划时通过闭式一阶修正强制执行，该修正将每个目标导向的潜在步长投影回CBF约束。在7自由度Franka Panda机械臂上，CBF规划器在固定障碍物任务上达到75.6%的成功率，比35个调优分类器配置中的最佳结果高12.0个百分点，在多位置任务上达到83.8%。对衰减率$α$的扫描刻画了安全-性能权衡，最佳工作点在$α\in [0.10, 0.20]$。在完全通用的随机障碍物设置中，成功率降至33.0%，我们将其归因于障碍物盲训练转移与修正规划器访问状态之间的协变量偏移。

items.title_en: 3D Neural Rendering for Automated Ultrasonic Laser Scans
items.title_zh: 用于自动化超声激光扫描的3D神经渲染
items.abstract_en: Laser doppler vibrometer (LDV) scans can be used to detect defects and cracks in manufactured parts before they are deployed. This work presents a method for reconstructing the steady-state surface wavefield of a three-dimensional part by combining automated robotic manipulation with neural rendering. A six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) robotic manipulator (UFactory xArm6) with an embedded piezoelectric transducer presented an acoustically excited test article to a stationary LDV at a sequence of known orientations, yielding a set of complex-valued 2D scans with poses derived analytically from the arm kinematics rather than from image-based pose estimation. These scans were used to train a novel complex-nerfacto model, a modified Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) pipeline that replaces the standard three-channel RGB output head with a two-channel output. Complex-nerfacto represents the real and imaginary velocity components of a wavefield, preserving the complex measurement without quantization. Reconstructions of a welded aluminum cylinder and a welded T-bracket were evaluated against measured scans using Z-normalized cross-correlation (ZNCC). The complex-valued pipeline achieved a mean ZNCC of 0.60 at held-out viewing angles, compared with 0.28 for a baseline RGB nerfacto model trained on rendered images of the same data. The resulting surface wavefield reconstructions supported defect detection and characterization on complex components. We identify geometry reconstruction from sparse LDV scans as the remaining obstacle to practical deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 激光多普勒振动计（LDV）扫描可用于在制造零件投入使用前检测其缺陷和裂纹。本工作提出一种通过结合自动化机器人操作与神经渲染来重建三维零件稳态表面波场的方法。一台六自由度（6-DOF）机器人机械臂（UFactory xArm6）带有嵌入式压电换能器，以一系列已知姿态将声激励测试件呈现给静止的LDV，产生一组复值二维扫描，其位姿由机械臂运动学解析推导，而非来自基于图像的位姿估计。这些扫描用于训练一种新颖的complex-nerfacto模型，这是一种修改后的神经辐射场（NeRF）流程，将标准三通道RGB输出头替换为双通道输出。Complex-nerfacto表示波场的实部和虚部速度分量，在无量化的情况下保留复数测量。使用Z归一化互相关（ZNCC）将焊接铝圆柱和焊接T形支架的重建结果与实测扫描进行评估。复值流程在留出视角下达到平均ZNCC 0.60，而在相同数据的渲染图像上训练的基线RGB nerfacto模型为0.28。所得表面波场重建支持复杂部件上的缺陷检测与表征。我们将从稀疏LDV扫描进行几何重建确定为实际部署的剩余障碍。

items.title_en: SKiD-SLAM: Resource-Aware Distributed Multi-Robot LiDAR SLAM for Planetary Missions with Field Deployments at Analog Sites
items.title_zh: SKiD-SLAM：面向行星任务的资源感知分布式多机器人LiDAR SLAM及在模拟场地的实地部署
items.abstract_en: Future planetary exploration missions require teams of robots to collaboratively map unknown environments under severe communication limits, constrained onboard computation, and no central infrastructure. In this field report, we present SKiD-SLAM, a distributed multi-robot LiDAR simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system for such environments, and report its deployment across two mission concepts: cave exploration and scientific surface exploration. We survey the communication and computation budgets of actual planetary missions and select modules that fit these budgets for inter-robot place recognition, relative pose estimation, and distributed trajectory fusion. Before field deployment, we verify the assembled system on public datasets resembling planetary environments and in a simulator built on NASA JPL's Open Source Rover. We then validate SKiD-SLAM through field deployments in South Korea: a team of wheeled rovers explores the Majang lava-tube cave on Jeju Island, and quadruped robots carry out a crater-and-rock science scenario on a planetary analog terrain at the Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology (KICT) in Yeoncheon. Across both deployments, SKiD-SLAM reliably performed distributed multi-robot LiDAR SLAM within a 250 kbps inter-robot communication budget, demonstrating its feasibility under challenging field conditions. Supplementary materials, including code and field data, are available at https://sparolab.github.io/research/skid_slam/.
items.abstract_zh: 未来的行星探索任务需要机器人团队在严重通信限制、受限的机载计算和无中心基础设施的条件下协作建图未知环境。在本实地报告中，我们提出SKiD-SLAM，一种用于此类环境的分布式多机器人LiDAR同时定位与建图（SLAM）系统，并报告其在两个任务概念中的部署：洞穴探索和科学表面探索。我们调研了实际行星任务的通信和计算预算，并选择适合这些预算的模块用于机器人间位置识别、相对位姿估计和分布式轨迹融合。在实地部署之前，我们在类似行星环境的公开数据集上以及基于NASA JPL开源漫游车构建的仿真器中验证了组装后的系统。随后，我们通过在韩国的实地部署验证SKiD-SLAM：一组轮式漫游车探索济州岛的Majang熔岩管洞穴，四足机器人在韩国土木工程与建筑技术研究院（KICT）延川的行星模拟地形上执行陨石坑和岩石科学场景。在两次部署中，SKiD-SLAM在250 kbps的机器人间通信预算内可靠地执行分布式多机器人LiDAR SLAM，展示了其在挑战性现场条件下的可行性。补充材料（包括代码和现场数据）可在 https://sparolab.github.io/research/skid_slam/ 获取。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Generalizable Structure-Aware Keypoint Correspondence for Ca
items.title_en: Generalizable Structure-Aware Keypoint Correspondence for Category-Unified 3D Single Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向类别统一 3D 单目标跟踪的可泛化结构感知关键点对应
items.abstract_en: 3D single object tracking (SOT) in point clouds is essential for real-world 3D perception, yet it remains challenging due to data sparsity and large variations in scale and structure across diverse object categories. Most existing methods rely on a category-specific paradigm that trains separate models for each class, severely limiting scalability and generalization in real deployment. Extending these methods to a single model capable of tracking diverse object categories proves inadequate, as the significant variations across categories make it difficult to establish reliable geometric correspondences without category-specific priors. To overcome these limitations, we propose a Unified Structural KeyPoint Tracker (UniKPT), a novel structure-aware and generalizable framework for category-unified 3D point cloud tracking. UniKPT comprises three key modules: (1) an adaptive keypoint extractor that produces scale-aware and semantically meaningful keypoints; (2) a progressive correspondence aligner that establishes robust cross-frame geometric associations; and (3) a confidence-aware structural localization module that suppresses unreliable matches and leverages fine-grained structural relationships for precise 3D localization. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes and KITTI benchmarks show that UniKPT achieves new state-of-the-art performance in category-unified 3D SOT. On the challenging nuScenes dataset, our unified model further surpasses category-specific state-of-the-art trackers by 4.37% in Success and 5.16% in Precision.
items.abstract_zh: 点云中的 3D 单目标跟踪（SOT）对于真实世界 3D 感知至关重要，但由于数据稀疏以及不同物体类别之间尺度和结构的巨大变化，它仍然具有挑战性。大多数现有方法依赖类别特定范式，即为每个类别训练单独的模型，这严重限制了实际部署中的可扩展性和泛化能力。将这些方法扩展为能够跟踪多种物体类别的单一模型已被证明是不够的，因为类别之间的显著差异使得在没有类别特定先验的情况下难以建立可靠的几何对应。为克服这些限制，我们提出了统一结构关键点跟踪器（UniKPT），这是一种用于类别统一 3D 点云跟踪的新颖结构感知且可泛化的框架。UniKPT 包含三个关键模块：（1）自适应关键点提取器，用于产生尺度感知且语义有意义的关键点；（2）渐进式对应对齐器，用于建立鲁棒的跨帧几何关联；（3）置信度感知的结构定位模块，用于抑制不可靠匹配并利用细粒度结构关系进行精确 3D 定位。在 nuScenes 和 KITTI 基准上的大量实验表明，UniKPT 在类别统一 3D SOT 中取得了新的最先进性能。在具有挑战性的 nuScenes 数据集上，我们的统一模型在 Success 上进一步超过类别特定的最先进跟踪器 4.37%，在 Precision 上超过 5.16%。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation
items.title_en: ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation using Concept Vectors
items.title_zh: ConceptPose：基于概念向量的免训练零样本物体姿态估计
items.abstract_en: Object pose estimation is a fundamental task in computer vision and robotics, yet most methods require extensive, dataset-specific training. Concurrently, large-scale vision language models show remarkable zero-shot capabilities. In this work, we bridge these two worlds by introducing ConceptPose, a framework for object pose estimation that is both training-free and model-free. ConceptPose leverages a vision-language-model (VLM) to create open-vocabulary 3D concept maps, where each point is tagged with a concept vector derived from saliency maps. By establishing robust 3D-3D correspondences across concept maps, our approach allows precise estimation of 6DoF relative pose. Without any object or dataset-specific training, our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on common zero shot relative pose estimation benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by a relative 62% in average ADD(-S) score, including methods that utilize extensive dataset-specific training.
items.abstract_zh: 物体位姿估计是计算机视觉和机器人学中的基础任务，但大多数方法需要大量针对特定数据集的训练。与此同时，大规模视觉语言模型展现出显著的零样本能力。在这项工作中，我们通过引入 ConceptPose 连接这两个世界，这是一个既免训练又免模型的物体位姿估计框架。ConceptPose 利用视觉语言模型（VLM）创建开放词汇 3D 概念图，其中每个点都标记有源自显著性图的概念向量。通过跨概念图建立鲁棒的 3D-3D 对应，我们的方法可以精确估计 6DoF 相对位姿。无需任何针对物体或数据集的训练，我们的方法在常见的零样本相对位姿估计基准上取得了最先进的结果，在平均 ADD(-S) 分数上相对超过最强基线 62%，包括使用大量数据集特定训练的方法。

items.title_en: CME-CAD: Heterogeneous Collaborative Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning for CAD Code Generation
items.title_zh: CME-CAD：面向 CAD 代码生成的异构协同多专家强化学习
items.abstract_en: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is essential in industrial design, but the complexity of traditional CAD modeling and workflows presents significant challenges for automating the generation of high-precision, editable CAD models. Existing methods, such as 3D reconstruction from sketches, often produce non-editable, approximate models that fall short of meeting the stringent requirements for precision and editability in industrial design. Moreover, the reliance on text or image-based inputs often requires significant manual annotation, limiting their scalability and applicability in industrial settings. To overcome these challenges, we propose the Heterogeneous Collaborative Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning (CME-CAD) paradigm, a novel training paradigm for CAD code generation. Our approach integrates the complementary strengths of these models, facilitating collaborative learning and improving the model's ability to generate accurate, constraint-compatible, and fully editable CAD models. We introduce a two-stage training process: Multi-Expert Fine-Tuning (MEFT), and Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning (MERL). Additionally, we present CADExpert, an open-source benchmark consisting of 17,299 instances, including orthographic projections with precise dimension annotations, expert-generated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) processes, executable CADQuery code, and rendered 3D models. The CADExpert dataset is publicly available at https://modelscope.cn/datasets/zhuofanChen/CADExpert.
items.abstract_zh: 传统 CAD 建模流程复杂，高精度、可编辑 CAD 模型的自动生成极具挑战。现有方法（如草图三维重建）多产出不可编辑的近似模型，难以满足工业设计对精度与可编辑性的要求，且依赖文本或图像输入往往需要大量人工标注。为此，作者提出异构协同多专家强化学习（CME-CAD）范式，融合多模型的互补能力，促进协同学习，提升生成准确、约束兼容且完全可编辑 CAD 模型的能力，并设计了多专家微调（MEFT）与多专家强化学习（MERL）两阶段训练流程。同时发布开源基准 CADExpert，含 17,299 个实例，覆盖带精确尺寸标注的正交投影、专家思维链（CoT）过程、可执行的 CADQuery 代码与渲染三维模型。
items.highlight_zh: 多专家协同强化学习 + 1.7 万实例开源 CAD 基准
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】工业界希望由文字或图像直接生成可编辑、高精度的 CAD 模型，但传统 CAD 建模流程繁琐；已有的草图三维重建等方案只能给出不可编辑的近似几何，且需要大量人工标注，难以规模化应用。
【用了什么方法】作者提出 CME-CAD：把多个能力互补的模型组织成“异构多专家”，让它们协同学习，并用强化学习从反馈中优化输出。训练分两步：先做多专家微调（MEFT），让各专家适配 CAD 代码生成任务；再做多专家强化学习（MERL），进一步提升生成质量。
【有什么结果与资源】论文同时发布开源基准 CADExpert，共 17,299 个实例，每个实例配有带精确尺寸标注的正交投影图、专家撰写的思维链（CoT）推理过程、可直接执行的 CADQuery 代码以及渲染好的三维模型，并提供公开下载链接，便于复现与横向比较。
【为何重要】它把“多专家协同 + 强化学习”引入 CAD 代码生成，目标是产出准确、满足约束、完全可编辑的模型，而不是不可编辑的近似几何；配套的大规模、带推理过程与可执行代码的数据集，也为该方向提供了统一评测基础，有望降低工业设计自动化的门槛。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:SenseSearch: Empowering Vision-Language Models with High-Res
items.title_en: SenseSearch: Empowering Vision-Language Models with High-Resolution Agentic Search-Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: SenseSearch：通过强化学习赋予视觉语言模型高分辨率智能体式搜索推理能力
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are limited by static knowledge and insufficient fine-grained visual analysis, hindering their performance on knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks. While recent research has explored VLMs that employ external tools like search or cropping to enhance model performance, they typically employ tools in isolation and lack the ability to coordinate multiple tools effectively. To address this gap, we propose SenseSearch, the first agentic VLM for search-reasoning that supports adaptive multi-tool coordination via reinforcement learning (RL). Specifically, SenseSearch dynamically integrates the image search, text search, and image crop tools to tackle fine-grained and knowledge-intensive visual understanding challenges. We first construct a high-quality cold-start dataset to instill basic tool-usage behaviors. In the subsequent RL stage, we introduce Batch-Normalized Group Sequence Policy Optimization (BN-GSPO) algorithm to enhance the tool invocation and reasoning ability. To comprehensively evaluate the agentic VLMs on complex visual tasks, we introduce the HR-MMSearch benchmark, the first search-oriented benchmark composed of high-resolution images with knowledge-intensive and search-driven questions. Experiments demonstrate that SenseSearch achieves state-of-the-art performance on open-source search and fine-grained image understanding benchmarks, outperforming baselines by 19.18% on HR-MMSearch. SenseSearch provides a promising path toward agentic VLMs with effective and robust tool invocation capabilities. All code and data are released at https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-MARS.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）受限于静态知识与细粒度视觉分析不足，在知识密集和视觉复杂的任务上表现欠佳。已有研究虽让 VLM 调用搜索或裁剪等外部工具，但通常孤立使用，缺乏多工具协同能力。为此，作者提出 SenseSearch——首个通过强化学习（RL）支持自适应多工具协同的搜索推理智能体式 VLM。它动态整合图像搜索、文本搜索与图像裁剪工具，应对细粒度、知识密集的视觉理解挑战。作者先构建高质量冷启动数据集以植入基本工具使用行为，并在随后的 RL 阶段提出批量归一化组序列策略优化（BN-GSPO）算法来增强工具调用与推理能力。为全面评测，作者还提出 HR-MMSearch——首个面向搜索、由高分辨率图像与知识密集、搜索驱动问题组成的基准。实验表明 SenseSearch 在开源搜索与细粒度图像理解基准上达到最优，在 HR-MMSearch 上超过基线 19.18%。
items.highlight_zh: 首个多工具协同的智能体式 VLM，搜索推理领先 19.18%
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】当前 VLM 的知识是静态的，看细节也不够细，遇到知识密集或视觉复杂的题目容易答错。已有工作让模型调用搜索或裁剪等外部工具，但往往一次只用一个工具，不会协调配合，效果受限。
【用了什么方法】作者提出 SenseSearch，号称首个通过强化学习（RL）实现自适应多工具协同的智能体式 VLM。它能在推理过程中动态决定何时调用图像搜索、文本搜索和图像裁剪，从而兼顾细粒度识别与外部知识检索。训练分两步：先用高质量冷启动数据教会模型“怎么用工具”，再用强化学习提升调用与推理策略；RL 阶段提出了批量归一化组序列策略优化（BN-GSPO）算法。评测方面，作者构建 HR-MMSearch 基准，这是首个面向搜索、由高分辨率图像和知识密集、需检索才能回答的问题组成的基准。
【有什么结果】在开源搜索与细粒度图像理解基准上，SenseSearch 取得当前最优表现；在 HR-MMSearch 上比基线高出 19.18%。代码与数据均已开源。
【为何重要】它把“工具协同”而非“单一工具”作为智能体式 VLM 的核心能力，并给出可复现的训练算法与更贴近真实需求的评测基准，为多工具、可检索的视觉推理提供了一条可行路线。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:JoPPO: Hierarchical Photography Assessment via Contrastive J
items.title_en: JoPPO: Hierarchical Photography Assessment via Contrastive Joint Conditional Probabilistic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: JoPPO：基于对比联合条件概率强化学习的分层摄影评估
items.abstract_en: With the advancement of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), employing VLM-as-a-Judge for visual evaluation has become a widely adopted metric in vision research. However, existing VLM-as-a-Judge approaches suffer from biased scoring outcomes with low discrimination and lack the capacity for unified multi-attribute compositional assessment. To address these limitations, we propose a novel training paradigm, termed JoPPO (**Jo**int **P**robabilistic **P**olicy **O**ptimization) that enables the VLMs to learn ranking under compositional assessment constraints. We evaluate the JoPPO on image aesthetics as a testbed, a task requiring nuanced understanding of multiple attributes including composition, lighting, color and geometry. Training follows two stages: (1) Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on synthetic composition dataset provided by automated data generation pipeline to instill compositional priors; and (2) Contrastive Joint Conditional Probabilistic Reinforcement Learning: building upon the GRPO algorithm, we introduce JoPPO, which compute reward based on the expected win rate of total scores derived from the conditional distribution of fine-grained attribute scores within batches, effectively enhancing the model's discriminative ability in composite evaluation. Across standard aesthetic benchmarks, our method achieves consistent improvements in ranking consistency, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization.
items.abstract_zh: 随着视觉-语言模型（VLM）的发展，采用 VLM-as-a-Judge 进行视觉评估已成为视觉研究中广泛采用的指标。然而，现有的 VLM-as-a-Judge 方法存在评分偏差、区分度低的问题，并且缺乏统一的多属性组合评估能力。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种新的训练范式，称为 JoPPO（Joint Probabilistic Policy Optimization，联合概率策略优化），使 VLM 能够在组合评估约束下学习排序。我们以图像美学作为测试平台评估 JoPPO，该任务需要对构图、光照、颜色和几何等多个属性进行细致理解。训练分为两个阶段：（1）在由自动化数据生成流程提供的合成构图数据集上进行监督微调（SFT），以注入构图先验；（2）对比联合条件概率强化学习：在 GRPO 算法基础上，我们引入 JoPPO，它基于批次内细粒度属性分数的条件分布所得到的总分期望胜率计算奖励，从而有效增强模型在组合评估中的判别能力。在标准美学基准上，我们的方法在排序一致性方面取得一致提升，展现出较强的零样本泛化能力。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Taming Preference Mode Collapse via Directional Decoupling A
items.title_en: Taming Preference Mode Collapse via Directional Decoupling Alignment in Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 通过方向解耦对齐在扩散强化学习中驯服偏好模式崩溃
items.abstract_en: Recent studies have demonstrated significant progress in aligning text-to-image diffusion models with human preference via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. However, while existing methods achieve high scores on automated reward metrics, they often lead to Preference Mode Collapse (PMC)-a specific form of reward hacking where models converge on narrow, high-scoring outputs (e.g., images with monolithic styles or pervasive overexposure), severely degrading generative diversity. In this work, we introduce and quantify this phenomenon, proposing DivGenBench, a novel benchmark designed to measure the extent of PMC. We posit that this collapse is driven by over-optimization along the reward model's inherent biases. Building on this analysis, we propose Directional Decoupling Alignment (D^2-Align), a novel framework that mitigates PMC by directionally correcting the reward signal.Specifically, our method first learns a directional correction within the reward model's embedding space while keeping the model frozen.This correction is then applied to the reward signal during the optimization process, preventing the model from collapsing into specific modes and thereby maintaining diversity. Our comprehensive evaluation, combining qualitative analysis with quantitative metrics for both quality and diversity, reveals that D^2-Align achieves superior alignment with human preference.
items.abstract_zh: 近期研究表明，通过人类反馈强化学习将文本到图像扩散模型与人类偏好对齐已取得显著进展。然而，现有方法虽在自动奖励指标上获得高分，却常常导致偏好模式崩溃（PMC）——一种特定形式的奖励黑客，即模型收敛到狭窄的高分输出（例如风格单一或普遍过曝的图像），严重降低生成多样性。在本工作中，我们引入并量化这一现象，提出 DivGenBench，一个用于衡量 PMC 程度的新基准。我们假设这种崩溃是由沿奖励模型固有偏差的过度优化驱动的。基于此分析，我们提出方向解耦对齐（D^2-Align），一种通过方向性校正奖励信号来缓解 PMC 的新框架。具体而言，我们的方法首先在保持奖励模型冻结的情况下，在奖励模型的嵌入空间中学习一种方向校正。然后在优化过程中将该校正应用于奖励信号，防止模型崩溃到特定模式，从而保持多样性。我们的综合评估结合定性分析以及质量和多样性的定量指标，表明 D^2-Align 实现了与人类偏好更优的对齐。

items.title_en: ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors
items.title_zh: ReVA-HPE：基于合成位姿监督与个性化虚拟锚点的相对6DoF头部姿态估计
items.abstract_en: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/
items.abstract_zh: 单目头部姿态估计通常建模为对单张人脸裁剪的绝对回归，但许多应用会持续观察同一人，可提供明确的锚定图像。相对头部姿态估计把问题转为估计锚定与查询图像之间的相对几何变化，然而现有方法在推理时仍需已知锚定姿态。我们将相对估计扩展到完整 6DoF，额外预测深度归一化的相对平移，与锚定组合即可恢复相机坐标系下的度量姿态。为免去真实锚定姿态，我们从单张无标注注册图重建个性化虚拟化身，渲染一簇已知姿态的虚拟锚点：多锚共识给出稳健旋转假设，真实注册图经 landmark PnP 充当平移分支的真实锚点；并提出在注册时一次性摊销锚点开销的高效变体。估计器仅用合成人脸渲染训练，不用真实姿态监督、伪标签、域适应或评测集微调。在 BIWI 与 FaMoS 上取得最优旋转精度，度量平移亦具竞争力。
items.highlight_zh: 免真值锚定姿态的 6DoF 相对头姿估计，纯合成数据训练
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：单目头姿估计一般被当作“单张人脸图直接回归绝对姿态”，但很多场景其实长期观察同一个人，能额外提供一张锚定照片——于是“相对头姿”更合适。然而已有相对方法在推理时仍要求知道锚定图的真实姿态，实用性大打折扣，且只处理旋转。
方法：作者先把相对估计扩展到完整 6DoF，多预测一个深度归一化的相对平移，与锚定组合即可还原相机坐标系下的度量姿态。为摆脱对真值锚定姿态的依赖，他们用一张无标注注册照片重建个性化虚拟化身，渲染出一簇姿态已知的虚拟锚点：多个虚拟锚点投票（多锚共识）给出稳健的旋转假设，而真实注册图则通过 landmark PnP 为平移分支提供真实锚点。另有一个高效变体，把锚点簇的开销在注册时一次性算好，此后每次查询只做一次真实到真实的相对预测，精度损失有限。训练全部使用合成人脸渲染，不使用真实姿态标注、伪标签、域适应或在评测集上微调。
结果：在真实 6DoF 基准上，BIWI 以及给定近正面注册图的 FaMoS 上旋转精度达到最优；尽管只靠合成监督，度量平移仍具竞争力。
为何重要：它同时解决了“推理需真值锚定姿态”和“缺真实标注”两个落地障碍，适合部署在个人设备这类能长期观察同一用户的场景。

items.title_en: VerifLM: Physically Verified Image-Edit-Guided Goal Pose Generation for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: VerifLM：面向机器人操作的物理验证图像编辑引导目标位姿生成
items.abstract_en: Many manipulation goals are easier to visualize than to specify numerically through explicit geometric constraints. We present VerifLM, a framework that converts image-edited goal configurations into physically verified 6-DoF object poses for planning. Using an edited image, VerifLM recovers an initial relative pose between an active object and a passive object, then prompts a vision-language model to generate axis-wise sampling constraints and a task-specific validation program. Candidate poses are evaluated in a physics simulator, and the VLM selects the most task-consistent retained candidate. To operate without predefined object meshes or physical parameters, VerifLM reconstructs metric object geometry from RGB-D observations and constructs multiple hypothetical simulations with varying physics and geometry. Parallel-world validation evaluates candidates across geometry--physics variations and ranks them by the number of worlds in which they satisfy the validation program. We evaluate VerifLM on nine manipulation tasks. VerifLM achieves the highest task success on eight of nine tasks, with the largest performance gain on goals requiring precise orientation and contact relationships.
items.abstract_zh: 许多操作目标更易通过可视化表达，而非用显式几何约束给出数值。我们提出 VerifLM，把图像编辑得到的目标构型转换为经物理验证的 6-DoF 物体姿态以用于规划。给定编辑后的图像，VerifLM 先恢复主动物体与被动目标物体之间的初始相对姿态，再提示视觉语言模型生成逐轴采样约束和任务相关的验证程序。候选姿态在物理仿真器中评估，VLM 从中选出最符合任务的保留候选。为摆脱预定义物体网格与物理参数，VerifLM 从 RGB-D 观测重建度量物体几何，并构建多组物理与几何各异的假设仿真；平行世界验证在几何—物理变化下评估候选，并按满足验证程序的世界数量排序。在九个操作任务上，VerifLM 在其中八个取得最高任务成功率，且在需要精确朝向与接触关系的目标上提升最大。
items.highlight_zh: 图像编辑目标经平行世界物理验证，9 任务 8 胜
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：很多机器人操作的目标“画出来比写成参数容易”——用户能说出要摆成什么样，却难以给出精确的几何约束数值。问题于是变成：如何把一张编辑后的目标图片，转成规划器可用的、物理上站得住的 6-DoF 目标姿态。
方法：VerifLM 先根据编辑图恢复主动物体与被动参照物之间的初始相对姿态；再让视觉语言模型（VLM）生成逐轴采样约束，以及一段针对具体任务的验证程序。候选姿态被丢进物理仿真器中试跑，由 VLM 挑出最符合任务的幸存候选。为摆脱预定义物体网格和物理参数，它从 RGB-D 观测重建度量尺度的物体几何，并构建多组几何与物理假设各不相同的仿真——“平行世界”验证，最后按候选在多少个世界中通过验证程序来排序。
结果：在九个操作任务上，VerifLM 在其中八个取得最高任务成功率；增益最大的是那些需要精确朝向与接触关系的目标。
为何重要：它把“图像编辑”这种直观的人机接口与物理仿真的严格校验结合起来，减少了对人工建模和精确约束标注的依赖，使以可视化的方式指定操作目标变得可行。

items.title_en: When to Probe and When to Act: Clarity-Aware Risk-Adaptive Control for Interactive Driving
items.title_zh: 何时探测与何时行动：面向交互式驾驶的清晰度感知风险自适应控制
items.abstract_en: Safe navigation in interactive traffic requires autonomous vehicles to reason about unobservable human characteristics and the reciprocal nature of multi-agent interactions. Traditional architectures often decouple prediction from planning, leading to the "Frozen Robot Problem" or unsafe maneuvers under high ambiguity because they treat risk assessment and information acquisition as independent objectives. We argue that the notion of safety should not remain static but must instead dynamically co-evolve with the system's internal confidence: the robot should actively clarify ambiguity when necessary while also recognizing the diminishing returns of information, and naturally transition toward task execution. We introduce a unified belief-space Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework that couples multistep information planning with a clarity-adaptive Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) barrier mechanism. By treating clarity, a scalar informational state, as an explicit planning variable, the controller co-designs its probing strategy with its safety specification, tightening conservatism under high ambiguity and relaxing constraints as confidence improves. We further provide a performance analysis showing that the cost of information seeking and the expected planning-cost gap to a controller that knows the true human characteristic are bounded by residual ambiguity and solver error. We evaluate the framework in lane-merging and unsignalized-intersection scenarios against representative interactive-planning baselines. Across 5,000 simulations, the proposed method achieves the highest success rates (94.6% and 93.2%) and the lowest collision rates (1.2% and 1.4%) among the compared methods, providing a principled foundation for robust decision-making in human-centric environments.
items.abstract_zh: 交互式交通中的安全导航要求自动驾驶车辆推理不可观测的人类特征以及多智能体交互的互惠性质。传统架构通常将预测与规划解耦，导致“冻结机器人问题”或在高模糊性下的不安全机动，因为它们将风险评估和信息获取视为独立目标。我们认为安全概念不应保持静态，而必须与系统的内部置信度动态共同演化：机器人应在必要时主动澄清模糊性，同时认识到信息的收益递减，并自然过渡到任务执行。我们提出一个统一的信念空间模型预测控制（MPC）框架，将多步信息规划与清晰度自适应条件风险价值（CVaR）屏障机制耦合。通过将清晰度这一标量信息状态作为显式规划变量，控制器将其探测策略与安全规范协同设计，在高模糊性下收紧保守性，并随着置信度提高而放宽约束。我们进一步提供性能分析，表明信息寻求的成本以及与已知真实人类特征的控制器相比的期望规划成本差距受残余模糊性和求解器误差的界约束。我们在车道合流和无信号交叉口场景中，针对代表性交互规划基线评估该框架。在5,000次仿真中，所提方法在比较方法中取得最高成功率（94.6%和93.2%）和最低碰撞率（1.2%和1.4%），为以人为中心环境中的鲁棒决策提供了有原则的基础。

items.title_en: KlaskTron-IL: A Contact-Rich Adversarial Imitation Learning Benchmark with a Validated Sim-to-Real Bridge
items.title_zh: KlaskTron-IL：一个具有经验证的仿真到现实桥接的接触丰富对抗模仿学习基准
items.abstract_en: KlaskTron is an open-hardware physical platform for two-player adversarial reinforcement learning, with a learned actuator model that supports zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of trained policies. Building on this platform, we contribute KlaskTron-IL: a multi-tier imitation learning dataset (80k human demonstration timesteps collected directly on the physical robot, 320k symmetry-augmented timesteps, and synthetic expert trajectories up to 5M steps generated by the zero-shot-validated PPO policy), and diagnostic baselines that expose three characteristic failure modes of standard IL methods under contact-rich adversarial dynamics: BC's data scaling plateau, GAIL's interpretable but weak-gradient discriminator (Spearman $ρ= -1.0$ peg-ball proximity recovery, but a logit span under 0.1), and an asymmetric BC-prior x reward-density interaction. Because the policy interface used throughout this paper is the same one the actuator model bridges to hardware, a policy trained on this benchmark can run unchanged on the physical robot, as we demonstrate zero-shot for the strongest BC baseline, so long as its commands respect the actuator model's $\pm 0.2$ m/s identification range.
items.abstract_zh: KlaskTron 是一个用于双人对抗强化学习的开源硬件物理平台，其学习得到的执行器模型支持训练策略的零样本仿真到现实迁移。在此平台基础上，我们提出 KlaskTron-IL：一个多层级模仿学习数据集（直接在物理机器人上采集的 8 万个人类演示时间步、32 万个对称性增强时间步，以及由经零样本验证的 PPO 策略生成的至多 500 万步合成专家轨迹），以及诊断性基线，揭示标准模仿学习方法在接触丰富的对抗动力学下三种典型失效模式：BC 的数据缩放平台期、GAIL 可解释但梯度较弱的判别器（Spearman ρ = -1.0 的 peg-ball 接近恢复，但 logit 跨度低于 0.1），以及非对称的 BC 先验 × 奖励密度交互。由于本文始终使用的策略接口正是执行器模型桥接到硬件的同一接口，在此基准上训练的策略可以不经修改地在物理机器人上运行，正如我们对最强 BC 基线所展示的零样本运行，只要其指令遵守执行器模型 ±0.2 m/s 的辨识范围。

items.title_en: UniGS-SLAM: Monocular Gaussian SLAM with Enhanced Geometry and Open-Vocabulary Semantics
items.title_zh: UniGS-SLAM：具有增强几何和开放词汇语义的单目高斯SLAM
items.abstract_en: Monocular semantic SLAM aims to reconstruct scene geometry and build semantic maps from RGB observations. Existing Gaussian-based methods often attach semantic labels or features to evolving Gaussian primitives, making semantic fusion difficult to maintain and increasing reconstruction overhead. Hybrid Gaussian--voxel representations provide more stable semantic support, but often rely on RGB-D input or known poses and do not revise historical semantic evidence after geometry updates. We present UniGS-SLAM, an RGB-only framework that decouples open-vocabulary semantics from Gaussian reconstruction while preserving bidirectional interaction. Foundation priors enhance monocular depth and pose estimation, while semantic observations are fused into an independent sparse voxel map with observation provenance, enabling historical contributions to be revised as reconstruction evolves. The fused semantics further guide Gaussian filtering and local surface refinement. Experiments on Replica, ScanNet, and KITTI-360 show leading tracking, rendering, and geometric reconstruction performance among representative RGB-only methods, together with strong open-set semantic mapping on Replica and ScanNet. We also achieve a 2.37-fold reconstruction speedup over the fastest compared semantic SLAM baseline. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/UniGS-SLAM/.
items.abstract_zh: 单目语义SLAM旨在从RGB观测中重建场景几何并构建语义地图。现有基于高斯的方法通常将语义标签或特征附加到不断演化的高斯基元上，使语义融合难以维护并增加重建开销。高斯-体素混合表示提供更稳定的语义支撑，但往往依赖RGB-D输入或已知位姿，并且不会在几何更新后修正历史语义证据。我们提出UniGS-SLAM，一个仅使用RGB的框架，将开放词汇语义与高斯重建解耦，同时保留双向交互。基础模型先验增强单目深度和位姿估计，而语义观测被融合到具有观测来源的独立稀疏体素地图中，使历史贡献能够随着重建演进而被修正。融合后的语义进一步引导高斯滤波和局部表面细化。在Replica、ScanNet和KITTI-360上的实验表明，在代表性纯RGB方法中具有领先的跟踪、渲染和几何重建性能，并在Replica和ScanNet上实现强开放集语义建图。与最快的对比语义SLAM基线相比，我们还实现了2.37倍的重建加速。项目页面：https://3dagentworld.github.io/UniGS-SLAM/。

items.title_en: EgoThumb: A Vision-Driven Supernumerary Robotic Thumb for Autonomous Grasp and Holding Assistance
items.title_zh: EgoThumb：一种视觉驱动的额外机器人拇指，用于自主抓取与保持辅助
items.abstract_en: Supernumerary robotic fingers augment human dexterity by enabling a single hand to perform complex "hold-and-manipulate" tasks that typically require bimanual coordination. However, existing devices are often hindered by bulky hardware that limits interaction to large objects and rely on explicit hand motion triggers that lack environmental context. To address these challenges, we present EgoThumb, a fully open-source, vision-driven supernumerary robotic thumb. EgoThumb features a compact, dual tendon-driven finger whose actuation is relocated to the forearm, reducing distal weight while enabling precise active joint control. The system utilizes a visual imitation learning policy that maps egocentric images from a palm-facing camera directly to continuous joint positions. By implicitly decoding human intent from visual cues capturing both the hand and the object of interest, EgoThumb achieves robust autonomous manipulation and strong generalization across diverse users and environments. All hardware designs and software implementations are fully open-sourced at https://ego-thumb.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 额外机器人手指通过使单手能够执行通常需要双手协调的复杂“保持并操作”任务，增强人类灵巧性。然而，现有设备常受限于笨重硬件，使其交互仅限大型物体，并依赖缺乏环境上下文的显式手部运动触发。为应对这些挑战，我们提出EgoThumb，一个完全开源的视觉驱动额外机器人拇指。EgoThumb具有紧凑的双肌腱驱动手指，其驱动装置被移至前臂，减少远端重量并实现精确主动关节控制。系统采用视觉模仿学习策略，将来自面向手掌相机的自我中心图像直接映射为连续关节位置。通过从捕捉手和感兴趣物体的视觉线索中隐式解码人类意图，EgoThumb实现稳健的自主操作，并在多样用户和环境中具有强泛化能力。所有硬件设计和软件实现完全开源：https://ego-thumb.github.io。
items.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)

items.title_en: FlapSim: A Composable MuJoCo Simulation Platform and Reduced-Order Aerodynamic Model Hierarchy for Flapping-Wing Robotics
items.title_zh: FlapSim：面向扑翼机器人学的可组合MuJoCo仿真平台与降阶气动模型层级
items.abstract_en: Flapping-wing simulation need to reconcile high-frequency wingbeat aerodynamics with the slower dynamics relevant to flight control and reinforcement learning. We present FlapSim, a modular open-source MuJoCo simulation platform that combines robot descriptions, wing geometry, and composable aerodynamic models in a deterministic simulation pipeline. Across $48$ held-out scenarios spanning frequency, gimbal, wind, frequency-step, gust, and cross-robot flat-plate regimes, we compare five reduced-order configurations operating at $1\,\text{ms}$ with a $50\,μ\text{s}$ quasi-steady blade-element reference. The built-in hover cycle-averaged baseline achieves a $67.51\times$ CPU speedup but only $0.6593$ mean wrench fidelity. Combining multirate $21$-substep clock synchronization, three-dimensional linear/quadratic inflow and gust coupling, analytical blade-element geometry scaling, and phase-locked $1f\text{--}6f$ harmonics raises mean fidelity to $0.9646$ at a $65.19\times$ speedup in a five-block model. A streamlined four-block model without explicit step-transient lag states achieves $0.9662$ fidelity at a $67.98\times$ speedup. Controlled ablations show that stroke harmonics are particularly important during frequency transitions, improving held-out frequency-step fidelity by $+0.3176$. Transfer-function analysis explains this effect: fixed-window cycle averaging retains harmonic contributions when the wingbeat frequency changes, so within-cycle reconstruction also improves the filtered wrench. These results characterize the accuracy--computation tradeoff of the aerodynamic hierarchy and identify timing, inflow, geometry, and harmonic representation as central considerations for reduced-order flapping-wing simulation. The source code are available at: https://mingshanhe.github.io/FlapSim/\href{https://mingshanhe.github.io/FlapSim/}.
items.abstract_zh: 扑翼仿真需要协调高频翼拍空气动力学与与飞行控制和强化学习相关的较慢动力学。我们提出FlapSim，一个模块化开源MuJoCo仿真平台，在确定性仿真流程中结合机器人描述、机翼几何和可组合气动模型。在涵盖频率、万向节、风、频率阶跃、阵风和跨机器人平板工况的48个留出场景中，我们将五种运行于1 ms的降阶配置与50 μs准稳态叶素参考进行比较。内置的悬停周期平均基线实现67.51倍CPU加速，但平均力旋量保真度仅为0.6593。结合多速率21子步时钟同步、三维线性/二次入流与阵风耦合、解析叶素几何缩放，以及锁相1f–6f谐波，在五块模型中于65.19倍加速下将平均保真度提升至0.9646。一个无显式阶跃瞬态滞后状态的精简四块模型在67.98倍加速下达到0.9662保真度。受控消融表明，冲程谐波在频率转换期间尤其重要，将留出频率阶跃保真度提高+0.3176。传递函数分析解释了这一效应：固定窗口周期平均在翼拍频率变化时保留谐波贡献，因此周期内重建也改善滤波后的力旋量。这些结果刻画了气动层级的精度-计算权衡，并确定时序、入流、几何和谐波表示作为降阶扑翼仿真的核心考虑因素。源代码见：https://mingshanhe.github.io/FlapSim/。

items.title_en: Value Function-Guided MPPI for Hierarchical Planning and Control in Off-Road Autonomous Navigation
items.title_zh: 值函数引导的MPPI用于越野自主导航中的分层规划与控制
items.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation in off-road terrain is commonly achieved using hierarchical control and planning architectures that rely on explicit cost maps and one-way information flow from a high-level planner to a low-level controller, decoupling planning from the true execution cost experienced during control. We propose a hierarchical planning and control framework in which information flows bidirectionally, allowing the low-level controller to guide trajectory selection at the planning level. The highest level of the hierarchy is a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control-style planner that determines optimal trajectories and passes these waypoints to a pretrained low-level reinforcement learning (RL) controller. Rather than drawing from an explicit cost map, our MPPI planner leverages the value function of the RL controller as an implicit cost representation. In this formulation, MPPI serves as a trajectory exploration mechanism, while the low-level controller's value function guides the search. To account for the distribution shift seen by the value function between training and evaluation, we propose an online policy evaluation process that adapts the value function to unseen driving experiences, and we demonstrate this adaptation in unseen off-road simulation environments. We evaluate our approach in a high-fidelity off-road driving simulator across a range of challenging terrain conditions and compare its performance against a baseline MPPI controller. The results demonstrate that our method achieves safer and more effective navigation to goal locations while eliminating the need for explicit cost maps and enabling tighter coupling between planning and control.
items.abstract_zh: 越野地形中的自主导航通常采用分层控制与规划架构，依赖显式代价地图以及从高层规划器到低层控制器的单向信息流，从而将规划与控制期间经历的真实执行代价解耦。我们提出一种分层规划与控制框架，其中信息双向流动，允许低层控制器在规划层引导轨迹选择。层级中的最高层是模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制风格规划器，它确定最优轨迹并将这些路点传递给预训练的低层强化学习（RL）控制器。我们的MPPI规划器不依赖显式代价地图，而是利用RL控制器的值函数作为隐式代价表示。在此形式中，MPPI充当轨迹探索机制，而低层控制器的值函数引导搜索。为考虑值函数在训练与评估之间看到的分布偏移，我们提出一种在线策略评估过程，使值函数适应未见的驾驶经验，并在未见的越野仿真环境中展示这种适应。我们在高保真越野驾驶仿真器中跨一系列挑战性地形条件评估方法，并与基线MPPI控制器比较性能。结果表明，我们的方法在无需显式代价地图并实现规划与控制更紧耦合的同时，能够更安全、更有效地导航至目标位置。

items.title_en: Gradient-Guided Orientation Learning for Weakly Supervised Oriented Object Detection
items.title_zh: 梯度引导的朝向学习用于弱监督有向目标检测
items.abstract_en: Weakly supervised oriented object detection (WS-OOD) aims to reduce the annotation cost of rotated bounding boxes by leveraging cheaper annotations such as horizontal boxes or points. However, these weak annotations provide no explicit orientation information, forcing existing methods to infer object angles through indirect geometric consistency or equivariant constraints. Such indirect supervision often becomes ambiguous and unstable under real-world appearance variations, including illumination changes, color shifts, shadows, and background clutter. In this paper, we present a simple yet effective gradient-guided orientation learning strategy for WS-OOD. Motivated by the observation that the input image itself contains useful orientation priors, our method extracts dominant gradient-based orientation cues from object regions and converts them into pseudo-angle labels for auxiliary supervision, enabling the detector to learn orientation-aware representations without requiring rotated bounding box annotations or extra learnable parameters. Furthermore, since AP can mask substantial angular errors when spatial IoU remains high, we introduce an orientation-aware evaluation metric that incorporates angular discrepancies into the standard AP protocol. Extensive experiments on weakly supervised oriented detection benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed pseudo-angle supervision improves both detection performance and orientation estimation quality, while the proposed metric provides a more faithful assessment of angle prediction than conventional AP alone.
items.abstract_zh: 弱监督定向目标检测（WS-OOD）旨在通过利用水平框或点等更廉价的标注来降低旋转边界框的标注成本。然而，这些弱标注不提供显式的方向信息，迫使现有方法通过间接的几何一致性或等变约束来推断物体角度。这种间接监督在真实世界外观变化下往往变得模糊且不稳定，包括光照变化、颜色偏移、阴影和背景杂乱。本文提出了一种简单而有效的用于 WS-OOD 的梯度引导方向学习策略。受输入图像本身包含有用方向先验这一观察启发，我们的方法从物体区域提取主要的基于梯度的方向线索，并将其转换为伪角度标签用于辅助监督，使检测器无需旋转边界框标注或额外可学习参数即可学习方向感知表示。此外，由于当空间 IoU 仍然较高时 AP 可能掩盖显著的角误差，我们引入了一种方向感知评估指标，将角度差异纳入标准 AP 协议。在弱监督定向检测基准上的大量实验表明，所提出的伪角度监督同时提升了检测性能和方向估计质量，而所提出的指标相比仅使用传统 AP 能提供更忠实于角度预测的评估。

items.title_en: Learning Object-Centric Motion Priors from Human for Robotic Dexterous Manipulation
items.title_zh: 从人类学习以物体为中心的运动先验用于机器人灵巧操作
items.abstract_en: Manipulating diverse objects with multi-fingered dexterous hands is challenging due to the high dimensionality and complex dynamics. Human-Object Interaction (HOI) datasets provide rich knowledge about task information and embodied interactions. Instead of solely imitating the human demonstrations, our method learns to holistically predict future hand-object states by leveraging these datasets. The predicted future states of the object can serve as a general-purpose reward term for reinforcement learning, reducing reliance on task-specific reward engineering and enhancing generalization across tasks. We conduct extensive experiments on three manipulation tasks in simulation and the real world. Our approach outperforms existing SOTA methods in both success rate and generalizability on novel objects. Furthermore, we validate the cross-embodiment compatibility of our methods by successfully deploying the skills on different robot hands.
items.abstract_zh: 使用多指灵巧手操作多样物体具有挑战性，因为其高维度和复杂动力学。人-物交互（HOI）数据集提供关于任务信息和具身交互的丰富知识。我们的方法不是仅模仿人类演示，而是利用这些数据集学习整体预测未来的手-物状态。预测的未来物体状态可作为强化学习的通用奖励项，减少对任务特定奖励工程的依赖，并增强跨任务泛化。我们在仿真和真实世界的三个操作任务上进行大量实验。我们的方法在新物体上的成功率和泛化性均优于现有SOTA方法。此外，我们通过在不同机器人手上成功部署技能，验证了方法的跨具身兼容性。

items.title_en: Riemannian Optimization-based Whole-body Obstacle Avoidance for Mobile Continuum Robots in Cluttered Environments
items.title_zh: 基于黎曼优化的移动连续体机器人在杂乱环境中的全身避障
items.abstract_en: Inspired by the coordination of global motion and local shape adaptation in snakes, elephant trunks, and octopus arms, we propose a unified planning and control framework for mobile continuum robots in cluttered and confined environments. Existing approaches often address high-level path planning and local motion control separately, limiting coordinated base-arm motion, kinematic consistency, and collision avoidance. Our framework integrates long-horizon trajectory planning with real-time geometric refinement under kinematic and environmental constraints. The global layer combines A* search with minimum-jerk planning to generate smooth reference trajectories. The local layer uses a geometry-consistent inverse kinematics solver and Riemannian optimization to coordinate mobile-base motion and continuum deformation while avoiding obstacles. We evaluate the framework through simulated pipe-traversal tasks with multiple baseline planners and real-world experiments involving navigation among dense obstacles and manipulation in confined spaces. Results demonstrate improved motion consistency, feasibility, and adaptability, supporting coordinated whole-body motion of mobile continuum robots in constrained environments.
items.abstract_zh: 受蛇、象鼻和章鱼臂中全局运动与局部形状适应协调的启发，我们提出一种用于杂乱且受限环境中移动连续体机器人的统一规划与控制框架。现有方法通常分别处理高层路径规划和局部运动控制，限制了基座-臂协调运动、运动学一致性和避障。我们的框架在运动学和环境约束下，将长时域轨迹规划与实时几何细化相结合。全局层将 A* 搜索与最小加加速度（minimum-jerk）规划相结合，以生成平滑参考轨迹。局部层使用几何一致逆运动学求解器和黎曼优化，在避障的同时协调移动基座运动与连续体变形。我们通过使用多个基线规划器的模拟管道穿越任务，以及涉及密集障碍物中导航和受限空间操作的实物实验来评估该框架。结果表明，运动一致性、可行性和适应性得到改善，支持移动连续体机器人在受限环境中实现协调的全身运动。

items.title_en: Beyond Terminal Constraints: Reliable Robot Control with Learned Safe Sets
items.title_zh: 超越终端约束：使用学习安全集的可靠机器人控制
items.abstract_en: Ensuring safety in advanced robot control methods such as Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Reinforcement Learning remains an open challenge. A common approach relies on control-invariant sets, yet their exact computation for nonlinear systems is generally intractable, and numerical approximations compromise theoretical guarantees. In this work, we show that safety does not need to rely exclusively on control invariance. We introduce novel classes of safe sets, each broader than classical control-invariant sets, and analyze corresponding MPC schemes that guarantee recursive feasibility by constraining different nodes of the prediction horizon rather than only the terminal state. Furthermore, when the safe set is an inner approximation of a suitable control-invariant set, our methods can ensure safety through a safe-abort strategy, even in the absence of recursive feasibility. We validate our approaches in extensive simulations on a 6-joint robot manipulator, showing fewer constraint violations than state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable tracking performance and computational efficiency. Hardware experiments further demonstrate the practicality of our schemes for real-world robotic applications.
items.abstract_zh: 在模型预测控制（MPC）和强化学习等先进机器人控制方法中确保安全性仍是一个未解决的挑战。一种常见方法依赖控制不变集，但其对非线性系统的精确计算通常难以处理，数值近似会损害理论保证。在这项工作中，我们表明安全性不必仅依赖控制不变性。我们引入新的安全集类别，每一类都比经典控制不变集更广，并分析相应的 MPC 方案：这些方案通过约束预测时域的不同节点而非仅终端状态来保证递归可行性。此外，当安全集是合适控制不变集的内近似时，即使不存在递归可行性，我们的方法也能通过安全中止策略确保安全性。我们在 6 关节机械臂上进行大量仿真验证，结果表明，与最先进方法相比，我们的方法在保持相当跟踪性能和计算效率的同时，约束违反更少。硬件实验进一步证明了我们的方案在真实机器人应用中的实用性。

items.title_en: A Multi-Layer Navigation System for Smart Wheelchairs with a Limited Input Interface
items.title_zh: 一种面向有限输入接口智能轮椅的多层导航系统
items.abstract_en: Smart wheelchairs are robotic devices that gather information from the surroundings and allow people to safely drive through various environments. They usually rely on the interpretation of high-level user's intentions, typically decoded through human-robot interface (HRI) or brain-machine interface (BMI). However, navigating in an unknown environment and accurately understanding user commands remain significant challenges. Misinterpretation of commands or the environment can lead to user frustration, distrust of the system, or even unsafe situations. In this paper, we present a novel Multi-Layer Navigation System (MLNS) for a smart wheelchair that enables navigation in unknown environments while interpreting and safely contextualizing user's intentions even in the case of limited and faulty commands. The stack relies on a Virtual Sensors-Driven Potential Fields (ViSPF) method for obstacle detection that accounts for the wheelchair's actual size, a Model Predictive Control (MPC) module for trajectory generation, and an open-vocabulary computer vision algorithm for target identification. Finally, a system based on Priority Queue (PQ) was implemented for target selection. We validated our system on a real smart wheelchair with experiments involving 10 participants without disabilities, including scenarios with faulty input interfaces. The results demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our system in real-world environments, proving its potential for practical applications in assistive technologies.
items.abstract_zh: 智能轮椅是一种机器人设备，可从周围环境收集信息，并让使用者安全地穿行于各种环境。它们通常依赖对高层用户意图的解读，通常通过人机接口（HRI）或脑机接口（BMI）解码。然而，在未知环境中导航并准确理解用户命令仍是重大挑战。对命令或环境的误解可能导致用户沮丧、对系统失去信任，甚至产生不安全情况。在本文中，我们提出一种面向智能轮椅的新型多层导航系统（MLNS），该系统能够在未知环境中导航，同时在命令有限且存在错误的情况下解读用户意图并将其安全地情境化。该技术栈依赖一种考虑轮椅实际尺寸的虚拟传感器驱动势场（ViSPF）方法进行障碍物检测、一个用于轨迹生成的模型预测控制（MPC）模块，以及一种用于目标识别的开放词汇计算机视觉算法。最后，实现了一个基于优先队列（PQ）的系统用于目标选择。我们在真实智能轮椅上通过涉及 10 名无残疾参与者的实验验证了系统，包括输入接口故障场景。结果表明，我们的系统在真实环境中具有鲁棒性和有效性，证明了其在辅助技术实际应用中的潜力。

items.title_en: Teleoperation System for Service Robots using Virtual Reality Headset and Pose Estimation
items.title_zh: 使用虚拟现实头显和姿态估计的服务机器人遥操作系统
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a teleoperation system for service robots that integrates human pose estimation with virtual reality (VR) to enable intuitive remote control. By using the Mediapipe framework for 2D pose detection and extending it with RGB-D data from the Intel RealSense D455 camera, a comprehensive 3D human pose estimation is achieved. This data is then mapped to the robot's kinematics, allowing the operator to control the robot's movements naturally. A VR interface was developed to provide an immersive perspective, enhancing the operator's situational awareness. Real-world experiments were conducted using the CHARMIE service robot to validate the system's effectiveness in tasks involving object manipulation. While the current system successfully demonstrates the potential of VR-based teleoperation, challenges remain in accurately capturing certain joint angles (e.g., wrist yaw) and ensuring precise mapping between human and robot movements. Future work includes the integration of inertial measurement units (IMUs) for improved rotational tracking and the implementation of more advanced control algorithms. Overall, this research contributes to the development of more intuitive and effective teleoperation systems for service robots, facilitating their deployment in complex and dynamic environments. This work further introduces a novel approach to teleoperation by combining RGB-D sensing with an innovative algorithm for real-time joint angle computation using Mediapipe, enhancing the precision of human-robot motion mapping and enabling immersive control through a VR interface. These contributions represent significant advancements in the field of human-robot interaction, particularly for service robot applications.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于服务机器人的遥操作系统，该系统将人体姿态估计与虚拟现实（VR）相结合，以实现直观的远程控制。通过使用 Mediapipe 框架进行 2D 姿态检测，并结合 Intel RealSense D455 相机的 RGB-D 数据进行扩展，实现了全面的 3D 人体姿态估计。随后，这些数据被映射到机器人运动学，使操作者能够自然地控制机器人运动。开发了 VR 界面以提供沉浸式视角，增强操作者的态势感知。使用 CHARMIE 服务机器人进行了真实世界实验，以验证系统在涉及物体操作任务中的有效性。虽然当前系统成功展示了基于 VR 的遥操作潜力，但在准确捕捉某些关节角度（例如腕部偏航）以及确保人与机器人运动之间的精确映射方面仍存在挑战。未来工作包括集成惯性测量单元（IMU）以改进旋转跟踪，并实现更先进的控制算法。总体而言，本研究有助于开发更直观、更有效的服务机器人遥操作系统，促进其在复杂动态环境中的部署。这项工作还通过将 RGB-D 传感与一种使用 Mediapipe 实时计算关节角度的创新算法相结合，引入了一种新颖的遥操作方法，提高了人-机器人运动映射的精度，并通过 VR 界面实现沉浸式控制。这些贡献代表了人-机器人交互领域的重要进展，尤其是对服务机器人应用而言。

items.title_en: ODE Policy: Robot Learning via Action Dynamics, Not Actions
items.title_zh: ODE Policy：通过动作动力学而非动作进行机器人学习
items.abstract_en: Most robot policies, whether trained by imitation learning (IL) or reinforcement learning (RL), map observations to action values at discrete control steps and leave the continuity of physical motion to be learned implicitly. We propose ODE policy, which learns the dynamics of the action rather than the action itself. A neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) learns the vector field of the action by matching the integrated actions to the targets over short action chunks in IL and single control steps in RL. A lightweight diversity head captures multi-modal behavior by randomizing the direction of the field. At deployment, each action is integrated from the previous one, so the executed trajectory is continuous by construction. We evaluate it as a visuomotor policy, as the action head of vision-language-action (VLA) and world action models (WAMs), and as the actor of model-based RL against 14 baselines on unimanual, bimanual, dexterous, locomotion, and loco-manipulation tasks. In IL, against flow matching, it reaches 5.9$\times$ the success, 5.4$\times$ the generalization, and 3.9$\times$ the mode balance after one epoch, and generates actions 10.8$\times$ faster. It mostly moves more smoothly than human demonstrations. On 14 real-world tasks across single-arm, dual-arm, dexterous, and humanoid robots, it achieves the highest success rate. In RL, it further speeds up SuperMimic for humanoid motion tracking and smooths its actions. Efficient in learning, data, parameters, and execution, ODE policy offers a promising path to scaling robot learning.
items.abstract_zh: 大多数机器人策略，无论是通过模仿学习（IL）还是强化学习（RL）训练，都在离散控制步上将观测映射为动作值，并将物理运动的连续性留给隐式学习。我们提出 ODE Policy，它学习动作的动力学而非动作本身。神经常微分方程（ODE）通过在 IL 中短动作块上以及在 RL 中单个控制步上将积分动作与目标匹配，学习动作的向量场。一个轻量级多样性头通过随机化场的方向来捕捉多模态行为。在部署时，每个动作由前一个动作积分得到，因此执行的轨迹在构造上就是连续的。我们将其作为视觉运动策略、作为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）的动作头，以及作为基于模型 RL 的 actor，在单臂、双臂、灵巧、运动控制和移动操作任务上与 14 个基线进行评估。在 IL 中，与流匹配相比，它在一个 epoch 后达到 5.9 倍的成功率、5.4 倍的泛化性和 3.9 倍的模式平衡，并生成动作快 10.8 倍。它在大多数情况下比人类演示运动得更平滑。在跨单臂、双臂、灵巧和类人机器人的 14 个真实世界任务上，它取得了最高成功率。在 RL 中，它进一步加速了用于类人运动跟踪的 SuperMimic 并使其动作更平滑。在学习、数据、参数和执行方面高效，ODE Policy 为扩展机器人学习提供了一条有前景的路径。

items.title_en: Visual-Inertial RGB-D SLAM with Encoders for a Differential Wheeled Robot
items.title_zh: 面向差速轮式机器人的带编码器视觉-惯性 RGB-D SLAM
items.abstract_en: Recent years have seen multiple impressive results in visual-inertial odometry (VIO) techniques, by which accurate state estimation can be achieved via the extended Kalman filter (EKF) or nonlinear optimization. However, these approaches are rarely open source, and they tend to fail in real experiments due to the temporary lack of feature points and fast motion. Therefore, in this study, we used encoders to overcome the temporary failure of purely vision-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Here, we propose a generative measurement model for encoders and derive an expression for the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate and necessary Jacobians for optimization. We use our theory to present a novel tightly coupled visual-inertial encoder RGB-Depth (RGB-D) SLAM system. Tests on our system on an in-house dataset confirmed that our modeling effort led to accurate (with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of approximately 2-7 cm) and robust state estimation in real time. The source code and our dataset containing the encoder information have been published for verification.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）技术取得了多项令人瞩目的成果，可通过扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）或非线性优化实现准确的状态估计。然而，这些方法很少开源，并且由于特征点暂时缺失和快速运动，它们在实际实验中往往失败。因此，在本研究中，我们使用编码器来克服纯视觉同步定位与建图（SLAM）的暂时失效。在此，我们提出一种用于编码器的生成式测量模型，并推导最大后验（MAP）估计的表达式以及优化所需的雅可比矩阵。我们利用该理论提出一种新型紧耦合视觉-惯性-编码器 RGB-深度（RGB-D）SLAM 系统。在我们内部数据集上对我们系统的测试证实，我们的建模工作带来了实时、准确（均方根误差（RMSE）约为 2-7 cm）且鲁棒的状态估计。源代码以及包含编码器信息的数据集已发布以供验证。

items.title_en: HIPC: Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control via Goal-Conditioned Motion Closure
items.title_zh: HIPC：通过目标条件运动闭合的人形机器人迭代规划与控制
items.abstract_en: Recent generative models are widely used to provide whole-body motion for humanoid tracking. Current methods combine motion generators with controllers in an open-loop paradigm, which leads to critical issues: tracking errors can accumulate into spatial drift, and the planner cannot adapt to unexpected physical disturbances without feedback from physical execution. However, directly feeding realized states back to the planner in a closed loop can cause discontinuities, resulting in physical jitter and even falls, since such states are out of distribution during training. To bridge this gap, we propose HIPC, a real-time Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control framework that couples a generative model with motion tracking into a unified planning-and-control paradigm. HIPC introduces a goal-conditioned motion planning trained with a canonical motion representation that avoids gimbal-lock singularities under extreme orientations and supports motion generation on diverse geometric and semantic conditions. Then, HIPC adopts two strategies, deviation-decayed recovery and history re-anchoring, to mitigate the out-of-distribution shift caused by realized-state feedback. Finally, HIPC operates a real-time asynchronous planning-and-control system, with latency compensation to reduce temporal mismatch for inference delay. Extensive experiments confirm the effectiveness of HIPC under switching and composition of diverse conditions. Results show that HIPC achieves state-of-the-art goal-reaching accuracy among existing methods while simultaneously demonstrating robustness to physical perturbations and the ability to recover from falls.
items.abstract_zh: 近期的生成模型被广泛用于为人形机器人跟踪提供全身运动。当前方法以开环范式将运动生成器与控制器结合，这会导致关键问题：跟踪误差会累积为空间漂移，且规划器在没有物理执行反馈时无法适应意外的物理扰动。然而，在闭环中直接将实际状态反馈给规划器可能造成不连续，从而导致物理抖动甚至摔倒，因为这些状态在训练期间是分布外的。为弥补这一差距，我们提出HIPC，一个实时人形机器人迭代规划与控制框架，将生成模型与运动跟踪耦合为统一的规划与控制范式。HIPC引入目标条件运动规划，并使用规范运动表示进行训练，该表示在极端姿态下避免万向节锁奇异，并支持在多样几何与语义条件下的运动生成。然后，HIPC采用偏差衰减恢复和历史重锚定两种策略，以缓解由实际状态反馈引起的分布外偏移。最后，HIPC运行实时异步规划与控制系统，并通过延迟补偿减少推理延迟带来的时间不匹配。大量实验证实了HIPC在多样条件切换与组合下的有效性。结果表明，HIPC在现有方法中实现了最先进的目标到达精度，同时展示出对物理扰动的鲁棒性和从摔倒中恢复的能力。

rm.usage: 人形机器人迭代规划与控制面向双足运动跟踪，与RM轮式/空中平台无关；其闭环重规划和延迟补偿思想对哨兵或空中轨迹跟踪仅有很弱启发。

items.title_en: Tactus: Tactile & Pose Sensing Glove for Natural Dexterity Data Collection
items.title_zh: Tactus：用于自然灵巧操作数据采集的触觉与位姿传感手套
items.abstract_en: Collecting naturalistic human manipulation demonstrations with accurate contact force and hand pose is essential for robot dexterous manipulation policy and foundational world model learning - yet no existing wearable platform provides both calibrated fingertip force sensing and occlusion-resilient hand tracking in a form factor that preserves natural manipulation behavior. We present Tactus, a textile-integrated sensing glove that co-optimizes three design pillars: (1) a thin, conformal 3D-knit form factor (1.5 mm fingertip stackup) designed to minimize interference with natural manipulation, (2) strategically placed capacitive tactile sensors at manipulation-relevant regions informed by empirical contact studies, and (3) IMU-fused pose tracking that maintains accuracy through the hand-object occlusions where manipulation data is most valuable. Tactus includes a documented calibration pipeline for cross-glove consistency and per-session calibration for subject-dependent correction. To enable objective comparison, we introduce standardized benchmarking protocols for tactile force regression and hand pose estimation, and apply them to Tactus and two commercially available tactile gloves - to our knowledge the first quantitative cross-platform evaluation of this kind. Tactus resolves a minimum detectable force of 0.59 N at 95% confidence, 1.6 - 2.7x lower than the commercial baselines, and with 0.87 cross-participant consistency, while our pose tracking sustains 11.0 mm fingertip keypoint relative error during manipulation, when occlusion is heaviest. We show that these combined signals support object property estimation, slip detection, and representative recording of hand-object interaction - yielding demonstration data with the fidelity required for contact-aware manipulation policies and world models.
items.abstract_zh: 采集具有准确接触力和手部位姿的自然人类操作演示，对于机器人灵巧操作策略和基础世界模型学习至关重要——然而，现有可穿戴平台尚无一种能在保持自然操作行为的外形尺寸下同时提供经过校准的指尖力传感和抗遮挡手部跟踪。我们提出Tactus，一种织物集成传感手套，协同优化三个设计支柱：(1) 薄型共形三维针织外形（1.5 mm指尖叠层），旨在最小化对自然操作的干扰；(2) 在经验接触研究指导下，将电容式触觉传感器策略性地布置于操作相关区域；(3) IMU融合位姿跟踪，在操作数据最有价值的手-物遮挡期间保持精度。Tactus包含用于跨手套一致性、且有文档记录的校准流程，以及用于受试者相关校正的每次会话校准。为实现客观比较，我们引入用于触觉力回归和手部位姿估计的标准化基准测试协议，并将其应用于Tactus和两款商用触觉手套——据我们所知，这是此类首个定量跨平台评估。Tactus在95%置信度下可分辨的最小力为0.59 N，比商用基线低1.6–2.7倍，并具有0.87的跨参与者一致性；而我们的位姿跟踪在遮挡最严重的操作过程中，指尖关键点相对误差保持在11.0 mm。我们表明，这些组合信号支持物体属性估计、滑动检测以及手-物交互的代表性记录——从而产生具有接触感知操作策略和世界模型所需保真度的演示数据。

items.title_en: Positive Safety Margins from Artificial Potential Field Reward Augmentation for Size-Robust Obstacle Avoidance under Partial Observability
items.title_zh: 部分可观测下尺寸鲁棒避障中由人工势场奖励增强产生的正安全裕度
items.abstract_en: Collision-free reaching is central to manipulation, yet real cells often leave the size and exact position of an obstacle unobserved, which excludes reinforcement learning controllers that take obstacle geometry as input. A reward limited to a collision penalty does not depend on the clearance outside the obstacle, so under a step cost its learned policy skims the obstacle surface and fails once the obstacle radius exceeds its training value. We investigate whether a single analytic reward term can induce a safety margin without exposing the obstacle to the policy. We augment the reward of a simulated Franka Emika Panda reaching task with a horizontal artificial potential field that penalizes proximity within a safety margin around each of two pillars (fixed nominal layout, random drift). Under hidden observation, policies trained with this term maintain a safe success rate above 88% across a radius sweep from 0.03 m to 0.055 m (30 seeds), while policies without it fall below 10% at the maximum tested radius; the term induces a minimum clearance of 47.9 mm against 9.6 mm without it and eliminates training collisions at least eight times earlier (median steps). The advantage is statistically significant at all out-of-distribution radii and holds across three reinforcement learning solvers and under full observation. Its safe success rate is comparable to that of a classical potential-field planner given the pillar positions. The margin is a fixed buffer rather than an adaptation to the radius, and it lengthens the path by about 19%.
items.abstract_zh: 无碰撞到达是操作的核心，但真实机器人单元常常无法观测障碍物的大小和精确位置，这排除了以障碍物几何为输入的强化学习控制器。仅包含碰撞惩罚的奖励不依赖于障碍物外部的间隙，因此在阶跃代价下，其学习到的策略会贴着障碍物表面掠过，并且一旦障碍物半径超过其训练值就会失败。我们研究单个解析奖励项是否能在不向策略暴露障碍物的情况下诱导出安全裕度。我们在仿真Franka Emika Panda到达任务的奖励中加入水平人工势场，对两根柱子各自周围安全裕度内的接近进行惩罚（固定标称布局，随机漂移）。在隐藏观测下，使用该奖励项训练的策略在0.03 m至0.055 m的半径扫描（30个随机种子）中保持高于88%的安全成功率，而不使用该奖励项的策略在最大测试半径下低于10%；该奖励项诱导出47.9 mm的最小间隙，而不使用它时为9.6 mm，并以至少提前八倍（中位步数）消除训练碰撞。该优势在所有分布外半径上均统计显著，并在三种强化学习求解器和完全观测下成立。在给定柱子位置时，其安全成功率与经典势场规划器相当。该裕度是固定缓冲，而不是对半径的自适应，并且使路径长度增加约19%。

items.title_en: CSO: Refining Robotic Policies via Skill Distribution Alignment and Skill-Grained Optimization
items.title_zh: CSO：通过技能分布对齐与技能粒度优化改进机器人策略
items.abstract_en: Discretizing continuous actions into discrete skills using methods like VQ-VAE has emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, quantization errors yield a suboptimal distribution for the skill prior, degrading its performance. While reinforcement learning offers a path for refinement, its direct application faces unstable encoder updates and a granularity dilemma in importance sampling. To address these challenges, we introduce Cascaded Skills Optimization (CSO), a two-stage post-training framework. First, Rejection-Sampling Supervised Fine-tuning aligns the model's observation-to-skill mapping with the distribution of successful online trajectories via supervised fine-tuning. Second, with the observation encoder frozen, Skills Policy Optimization computes an independent, clipped importance ratio for each complete skill, enabling stable and efficient updates. With a lightweight QueST-style policy, CSO raises overall LIBERO success from 80.1% to 97.5%, improves performance on RoboTwin2.0, and achieves 61.0% success across five physical single-arm tasks. Additional comparisons with FAST, discrete BEAST, and fixed-buffer IQL further validate the effectiveness of our two-stage post-training strategy.
items.abstract_zh: 使用VQ-VAE等方法将连续动作离散化为离散技能，已成为机器人操作的一种强大范式。然而，量化误差会使技能先验的分布次优，从而降低其性能。虽然强化学习提供了改进路径，但其直接应用面临编码器更新不稳定以及重要性采样中的粒度困境。为应对这些挑战，我们提出级联技能优化（CSO），一种两阶段后训练框架。首先，拒绝采样监督微调通过监督微调，使模型的观测到技能映射与成功在线轨迹的分布对齐。其次，在冻结观测编码器的情况下，技能策略优化为每个完整技能计算独立且裁剪的重要性比率，从而实现稳定且高效的更新。使用轻量级QueST风格策略，CSO将LIBERO总体成功率从80.1%提升至97.5%，改善RoboTwin2.0上的性能，并在五个真实单臂任务上实现61.0%的成功率。与FAST、离散BEAST和固定缓冲区IQL的额外比较进一步验证了我们两阶段后训练策略的有效性。

items.title_en: Online Learning of Heterogeneous Locomotion Dynamics under Reinforcement Learning Policies for Precise Loco-Manipulation
items.title_zh: 用于精确移动操作的强化学习策略下异构运动动力学在线学习
items.abstract_en: How to reuse a pretrained locomotion policy for precise loco-manipulation is still an open problem. We propose an online method to learn the closed-loop dynamics under a frozen locomotion policy. The learned model predicts floating-base motion and improves loco-manipulation accuracy. However, unobserved latent conditions of the policy introduce heterogeneous responses, meaning that the same observed state will lead to different motions. Direct learning without accounting for this heterogeneity introduces bias and fluctuations into dynamics estimates, degrading floating-base prediction and end-effector tracking. To address this problem, a contaminated Gaussian model is proposed to approximate the effects of latent conditions. The model uses two Gaussian components to approximate predictable and unpredictable responses under the same observed state. Then, the contaminated Gaussian model is combined with a Gaussian process to construct an online learner using random Fourier features (RFFs). The learner estimates each response's probability of belonging to the predictable component and uses it to weight online updates, capturing predictable responses while reducing bias and fluctuations caused by heterogeneous observations. With consistent and unbiased dynamics estimates, model predictive control (MPC) predicts floating-base motion accurately and enables precise loco-manipulation. A finite-sample error bound is established to ensure uniform convergence in online learning. Simulation and hardware experiments demonstrate consistent end-effector tracking across different manipulator configurations and tasks, with errors of 0.01 m.
items.abstract_zh: 如何复用预训练运动策略以实现精确移动操作仍是一个开放问题。我们提出一种在线方法，在冻结运动策略下学习闭环动力学。学习到的模型预测浮动基座运动并提高移动操作精度。然而，策略中未观测的潜在条件会引入异构响应，即相同的观测状态会导致不同运动。若直接学习而不考虑这种异构性，会给动力学估计引入偏差和波动，降低浮动基座预测和末端执行器跟踪性能。为解决该问题，提出污染高斯模型来近似潜在条件的影响。该模型使用两个高斯分量近似相同观测状态下的可预测响应和不可预测响应。然后，将污染高斯模型与高斯过程结合，使用随机傅里叶特征（RFF）构建在线学习器。该学习器估计每个响应属于可预测分量的概率，并用其为在线更新加权，从而捕捉可预测响应，同时减少异构观测引起的偏差和波动。借助一致且无偏的动力学估计，模型预测控制（MPC）能够准确预测浮动基座运动，并实现精确移动操作。建立了有限样本误差界，以确保在线学习中的一致收敛。仿真和硬件实验表明，在不同机械臂构型和任务下均能保持一致的末端执行器跟踪，误差为0.01 m。

items.title_en: Humanoid Dodgeball: Learning Fast Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Motions for Humanoids
items.title_zh: Humanoid Dodgeball：学习人形机器人的快速动态避障运动
items.abstract_en: Humanoids have become increasingly agile and capable in real-world environments. To operate safely in dynamic scenarios, they must rapidly evade fast-moving obstacles while maintaining stability and physically feasible whole-body motion. Learning such behaviors remains challenging due to the high-dimensional dynamics of humanoid systems and the need to jointly balance reactive obstacle avoidance, motion naturalness, and control robustness. In this work, we present Humanoid Dodgeball, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for agile dynamic obstacle avoidance in humanoids. Our method enables highly dynamic whole-body evasive maneuvers against incoming projectiles through threat-aware reward shaping, while multiple direction-specific adversarial motion priors regularize the learned behaviors toward stable and diverse human-like motions. Extensive simulation and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves dynamic obstacle avoidance performance across diverse obstacle speeds and launch distances, while preserving robust and physically plausible humanoid motions.
items.abstract_zh: 人形机器人在真实环境中已变得越来越敏捷和有能力。为在动态场景中安全运行，它们必须快速躲避快速移动的障碍物，同时保持稳定性和物理可行的全身运动。学习此类行为仍然具有挑战性，因为人形机器人系统具有高维动力学，并且需要同时平衡反应式避障、运动自然性和控制鲁棒性。在这项工作中，我们提出Humanoid Dodgeball，一种用于人形机器人敏捷动态避障的强化学习（RL）框架。我们的方法通过威胁感知奖励塑形，使机器人能够对来袭抛射物执行高度动态的全身规避动作，同时多个方向特定的对抗运动先验将学习到的行为正则化至稳定且多样的人类式运动。大量仿真和硬件实验表明，所提出框架在不同障碍物速度和发射距离下显著提升动态避障性能，同时保持鲁棒且物理合理的人形机器人运动。
